objective.text: Avoid explicitly exposing a hidden model secret through a custom resource array.

difficulty.rationale: Recognize that an explicit resource field can bypass model serialization hiding.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

class AccountView extends Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\JsonResource
{
    public function toArray($request): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $this->id,
            'token' => $this->api_token,
        ];
    }
}

stem: The model hides api_token. Does that protect this resource response from exposing it?

options.text: Yes; renaming api_token to token automatically preserves its hidden status.
options.rationale: The custom output key does not inherit a model hidden-list rule for another name.
options.misconception: The custom output key does not inherit a model hidden-list rule for another name.

options.text: No; hidden only works when the token is also listed in fillable.
options.rationale: Mass-assignment settings and serialization hiding are separate, and fillable does not solve this explicit exposure.
options.misconception: Mass-assignment settings and serialization hiding are separate, and fillable does not solve this explicit exposure.

options.text: Yes; hidden makes the attribute unreadable through all PHP property access.
options.rationale: The attribute still exists and can be accessed by application code.
options.misconception: The attribute still exists and can be accessed by application code.

options.text: No; the resource explicitly reads and returns the attribute, so the field must be removed or separately authorized.
options.rationale: Model hidden settings affect model array serialization; they do not prevent an explicit attribute read in a custom resource.
